class.name: GameplayRPCConfig
class.brief_description: Allowlisted gameplay RPC direction and payload policy.
class.description: Gameplay RPCs must be registered by object ID and name before use. Incoming packets are matched against this local policy; packet fields cannot grant server authority or gameplay ownership.

members.member: Maximum encoded argument size. The adapter also rejects any final packet over its 1200-byte safety budget rather than relying on UDP fragmentation.
For server RPCs, requires the authenticated transport sender to equal the server-recorded gameplay owner.

constants.constant: A joined client calls the authoritative server.
The server calls the object's gameplay owner.
The server calls one explicitly selected admitted client.
The server executes locally and calls every admitted client.
